what_it_is: Agent-operated development evidence on the same development build and the same kept home after setup: what the App shows on the next launch, signed out, read by views, by the link to the Settings & tools view, by opening disclosures, and by one account check. The labels are read from the App's source at the revision built (App.tsx, DailyWorkspace.tsx, DesktopSetupPanel.tsx, AccountStatus.tsx), not from a recorded view; a label that differs stops the walk there. It is not a person's observation and meets no criterion.
starting_state: The kept home after the setup walk, relaunched by the launcher with its network blocks on; no credential.
acts: views; one click on the Settings & tools link; clicks that open a disclosure; one press of Check account status, which asks the App's own Codex for the account state and changes nothing; one press of Read effective storage and plugin settings if the App offers it, which reads two settings from the App's own Codex and changes nothing; nothing typed
never_clicked: any control that starts, resumes or forks a conversation
window_holds: full screen button Help: this button also has an action to zoom the window, Secondary Actions: zoom the window
